# SD18 deterministic Human Bard level 13 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1..level-12 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_bard_level12_widening.rs) to level 13 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/performance posture from the level-1 through level-12
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The PF1
# Core Rulebook Bard class table's level-13 "Special" column is blank
# (verified independently against d20pfsrd, the Archives of Nethys
# aonprd.com mirror, and legacy.aonprd.com, all three byte-for-byte
# identical), so no new choice line is required.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no
# performance-state engine (start/maintain action economy, round
# tracking/consumption), no Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile
# Performance execution, no Suggestion execution, no Dirge of Doom execution,
# no Inspire Greatness execution, no untrained-skill-use execution for
# Jack-of-All-Trades, no Lore Master take-10/take-20 execution against any
# actual Knowledge check, no Soothing Performance healing/condition-removal
# execution, and no spontaneous known-spell / slot posture burden. Base
# attack bonus and all three base saves stay numerically unchanged from
# level 12 (integer-division coincidences: 13*3/4=9, 13/3=4, 13/2+2=8), the
# Bardic Performance rounds-per-day pool genuinely rises, and the Fascinate
# affected-creature count genuinely rises, while the Fascinate DC stays
# unchanged (13/2=6, an integer-division coincidence with level 12).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level13
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:13
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
